baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ / أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا / أَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The night's enacted rising concentrates force into planted contact; that contact also matches one element to another, so bodily traction and uttered speech become one alignment mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Setting out and rising supplies the enacted emergence of the night practice.
Doing something by night makes the phrase an activity rather than a merely dark interval.
Strength and hardness provide the concentrated force of the comparative.
A foot treading a place gives the force a bodily point of contact.
One thing matching another turns contact into concordance between body and speech.
Straightness and evenness make speech the upright result of the alignment.
Uttered speech identifies the verbal surface on which uprightness appears.

changed_reading.before: Night practice is simply more effective for concentration and correct speech.
changed_reading.after: The night rising is an embodied concordance: firmer foot-contact and better-matched utterance are two outputs of the same alignment.

baseline_models.mechanism: Growth under severe pressure matures into a supporting structure. The verse can therefore describe capacity being formed by repeated nocturnal exertion, not only a favorable moment already possessing that capacity.

activation_trace.role: Growing into youth supplies a developmental rather than instantaneous nashi'ah.
Arrival at full strength makes intensity a stage of maturation.
Severe pressing supplies the resistance through which capacity develops.
A mainstay or support is the durable capacity produced by the pressure.
Earnest concern for something makes qila a sustained verbal commitment.

changed_reading.before: The night has a fixed advantage over other times.
changed_reading.after: Nocturnal exertion develops the strength by which committed speech can later stand as a support.

baseline_models.mechanism: Speech begins as an unvoiced inner saying, is brought into action, and is matched to outward utterance; aqwam names the straight fit between intention and voiced form.

activation_trace.role: Beginning speech or action makes the night the point where saying starts to form.
An unspoken inner saying supplies the inward pole of qila.
Uttered speech supplies the outward pole that must agree with the inner saying.
Mutual matching provides the bridge from inward conception to voiced expression.
Straightness names the integrity of the resulting inner-outer fit.

changed_reading.before: Qila denotes only speech made easier to pronounce at night.
changed_reading.after: The night is where an inward saying is initiated and brought into straighter agreement with what the tongue voices.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee moves from wrapped enclosure and carried load into bodily rising. Nashi'at al-layl becomes the transition from bundled passivity to upright agency.

activation_trace.role: Rising and setting out anchors the focus as an enacted transition.
Bodily standing supplies the upright endpoint already latent in aqwam.
Wrapping in garments supplies the enclosed starting posture from which the night rising emerges.
Carrying a load makes the wrapping also a burden to be borne into action.
The explicit command to stand converts the focus's uprightness from quality into movement.

structural_cues: The vocative to the bundled one in 73:1 is followed immediately by the command to stand in 73:2.
The same standing root returns comparatively as aqwam in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrapping, load, command, and rising; I infer a directional passage from enclosure to agency. The live alternative is that the vocative names only the addressee and contributes no process to 73:6.

changed_reading.before: Nashi'at al-layl names an isolated nocturnal occurrence.
changed_reading.after: It is the act of unbundling a burdened self into standing agency, culminating in bodily and verbal uprightness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Standing, arranging recitation, receiving a cast saying, and bearing weight form a conditioning sequence. The focus's matching contact and supporting uprightness are adaptations for receiving and carrying the heavy utterance.

activation_trace.role: Matching makes nocturnal contact an adjustment of bearer to burden.
A mainstay supplies the load-bearing result of the adjustment.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter initiate the conditioning sequence.
Ordered arrangement gives the received saying a deliberately structured form.
Receiving speech turns the coming utterance into something the addressee must take up.
Uttered speech identifies the load as a saying rather than undifferentiated hardship.
Bearing a heavy load supplies the pressure for which nocturnal footing is trained.

structural_cues: The 73:2-5 sequence moves from standing through measured duration and ordered recitation to a heavy saying cast upon the addressee.
73:6 immediately explains that sequence with comparatives joining contact and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence stand, arrange, receive, and heavy saying; I infer that the earlier acts condition the bearer for the later load. The live alternative is a non-causal comparison in which night merely happens to be the clearest time for recitation.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a generic alignment available at night.
changed_reading.after: It describes a load-bearing reception protocol: ordered standing matches the bearer to a heavy utterance until that utterance can stand upright.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant mapping of focus qila to QLL lets the repeated qalilan activate fewness beneath the dominant speech reading. The result is a paronomastic model of upright speech delivered in deliberately small, bearable measures.

activation_trace.role: The split root's fewness branch places a small-measure echo under qila without replacing speech.
Carrying and rising lets the small verbal measure function as a bearable lifted load.
Equal weight and even measure make aqwam the calibration of the verbal dose.
The first qalilan supplies explicit smallness in the night-duration instruction.
The repeated qalilan reinforces small adjustment rather than maximal exertion.
A later little respite keeps measured smallness active beyond the opening instruction.

structural_cues: Qalilan closes 73:2 and 73:3, while qila closes 73:6; the packet explicitly retains QLL as a non-dominant mapped target for focus QWL.
The opening instructions repeatedly adjust duration by portions rather than demanding an undifferentiated maximum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated qalilan, focus qila, and the split mapping; I supply a sound-and-branch echo that overlays measured fewness on speech. The dominant and materially safer alternative remains ordinary QWL utterance with no QLL semantic transfer.

changed_reading.before: Aqwam qila means only more upright speech.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also hears upright speech as a carefully measured small verbal load, made bearable by dosing rather than excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Day opens into long, expansive movement, while night concentrates the practitioner at a point of contact. Ashaddu wat'an therefore becomes denser traction against daytime dispersal, not mere severity.

activation_trace.role: Night and darkness supply one pole of the explicit temporal contrast.
Concentrated pressure becomes the night pole's dense resistance and traction.
Straightness is the orientation preserved under that concentrated pressure.
Daylight opening supplies the exposed and expanded temporal field opposite night.
Expansive going about for livelihood makes daytime a field of dispersed mobility.
Long duration extends that mobility and sharpens the contrast with concentrated night contact.

structural_cues: 73:7 directly follows the focus and contrasts night with an extended daytime sabh.
The focus's contact image and the next ayah's movement image organize space differently: planted versus ranging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies night, pressure, opened day, expansive movement, and duration; I infer concentration versus dispersal as the contrastive arrow. The live alternative is that sabh denotes ample free time, making day less distracting rather than more diffuse.

changed_reading.before: Night is stronger because it is intrinsically harder or quieter.
changed_reading.after: Night is stronger because it converts the self's long daytime circulation into concentrated traction and a single verbal orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lingual remembrance and deliberate severance shape an inward saying before it meets circulating public talk. Self-restraint and beautiful withdrawal then define upright qila as ethically governed response rather than verbal dominance.

activation_trace.role: The inner saying supplies the speech that is regulated before public encounter.
Straightness makes integrity, not force over others, the criterion of response.
Remembrance running on the tongue supplies disciplined vocal practice.
Cutting and separation remove competing attachments from the speech-forming act.
Holding the self back from distress turns upright speech into controlled response.
Circulating talk supplies the social verbal pressure against which qila is tested.
Separation and departure provide the non-retaliatory action taken toward hostile talk.
Beauty in action qualifies withdrawal and makes restraint a positive verbal ethic.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from remembrance and exclusive turning in 73:8 to what others say and a beautiful withdrawal in 73:10.
The focus places qila under a comparative of uprightness before this social test appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vocal remembrance, separation, public talk, restraint, and beautiful withdrawal; I infer that night practice pre-forms the response later demanded. The live alternative is that the ritual and social commands are parallel obligations without a formative link.

changed_reading.before: Straighter qila is primarily clearer or more accurate recitation.
changed_reading.after: It is also speech ethically straightened before conflict: remembered inwardly, voiced without reactive capture, and capable of beautiful disengagement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene removes every external support: ground shakes, solid mountains become a poured heap, harmful weight seizes, and sky splits. Against that field, the focus's planted foot and upright saying become a practiced counter-footing carried within the person.

activation_trace.role: Foot-treading supplies the local bodily ground that can be practiced before outer ground fails.
Uprightness supplies an internal orientation that does not depend on stable terrain.
Strength and hardness provide the resistance needed for counter-footing.
Violent shaking removes confidence in the ground underfoot.
A hard elevated mass supplies the apparent external stability that is about to collapse.
Poured granular matter converts the mountain's solidity into unstable flow.
Harmful heaviness turns weight from formative resistance into destructive seizure.
Opening and splitting extend the loss of support from earth to sky.

structural_cues: 73:14 transforms mountains from stable mass into a poured heap while the earth shakes.
The sequence adds a heavy seizure in 73:16 and a split sky in 73:18, widening instability from body and ground to the whole frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies planted contact, uprightness, shaking terrain, poured mountains, harmful heaviness, and split sky; I infer a micro-to-macro rehearsal in which nocturnal stability prepares for external dissolution. The live alternative is that the later material scene only warns and does not explain the practice in 73:6.

changed_reading.before: The vigil stabilizes an individual during ordinary distraction.
changed_reading.after: It rehearses a portable footing and upright utterance for the moment when even ground, mountain, and sky cease to support orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Willing, taking, and a traversable path convert the focus's rising and foot-contact into route formation. Repeated nocturnal steps do not merely improve a state; they make an upright way toward the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Setting out toward a need supplies the departure onto a route.
Each foot-tread makes the route concrete through repeated contact.
Straightness supplies the route's orientation.
Will directed toward a thing supplies voluntary entry onto the route.
Taking and acquisition turn willingness into an adopted practice.
An extended traversable path gives the adopted practice a directional form.

structural_cues: 73:19 presents a voluntary taking of a path toward the Lord.
The focus already combines rising, treading, and straightness, a compact movement vocabulary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies willing, taking, path, rising, and foot-contact; I infer that repeated night action lays down the path it traverses. The live alternative is that the path remains a generic metaphor unrelated to the focus's bodily wording.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares the quality of one devotional period with another.
changed_reading.after: The night rising is a route-making practice: chosen steps and straight speech progressively constitute a path toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine measuring, human inability to enumerate, repeated ease, illness, and travel revise strong contact into adaptive fit. Wat' can be smoothing and matching, while aqwam can be even measure: the stronger practice is sustainable traction calibrated to actual capacity, not maximal hardship.

activation_trace.role: Making something smooth and easy opens a non-punitive sense of stronger wat'.
Matching makes strength a fit between practice and practitioner.
Equal weight and moderate measure define aqwam as calibration.
Repeated reading and recitation identify the activity whose amount is being recalibrated.
Agreement with proper measure and a middle limit supplies the governing calibration.
Exhaustive counting names the human precision that the verse says cannot be maintained.
Ease opening after difficulty supplies the explicit replacement for impossible exactitude.
Weakening and restricted movement make variable bodily capacity part of the measure.
Travel through the earth adds changing livelihood demands to the calibration.

structural_cues: 73:20 acknowledges multiple night fractions, inability to count them exactly, and twice directs recitation of what is easy.
Illness, travel for provision, and fighting are named as differing constraints within the same community.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine measure, failed enumeration, ease, recitation, illness, and travel; I infer that 73:20 retrospectively controls how 73:6's strength should be applied. The live alternative is that 73:20 is only a later concession and leaves the earlier comparative's severity unchanged.

changed_reading.before: Stronger wat' recommends maximizing nocturnal difficulty and duration.
changed_reading.after: Stronger wat' is calibrated traction: recitation is matched to real capacity, and its uprightness includes sustainable measure and divinely authorized ease.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a technical same-rhyme branch of wat' inside a Qur'anic recitation setting. It remains anchored in focus wat'an, aqwam, and qila and is sharpened by explicit ordering and reading in 73:4. Downstream prose should present it only as a prosodic analogy for cadence and verbal placement, never as a lexical claim that the verse praises a poetic rhyme fault.

activation_trace.role: Repeating a rhyme word supplies a technical acoustic placement image for wat'.
Equal weight and measure turn aqwam toward balanced cadence.
Uttered speech keeps the acoustic model attached to qila.
Ordered arrangement turns the technical recurrence image into controlled verbal sequence.
Reading and recitation locate the ordered cadence in voiced performance.

changed_reading.before: The night improves only semantic clarity or mental attention.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also locks utterance into more stable acoustic placement, even weight, and ordered cadence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines conception, intercourse, birth, origination, and womb branches into a model of speech formation. It remains visibly anchored in focus nashi'ah, wat', and qila, with later birth and womb images providing context activation. Downstream prose must mark it as a generative or gestational metaphor for an utterance taking form, not as the lexical sense of the ayah or a claim about sexual ritual.

activation_trace.role: Conception and the beginning of pregnancy make nashi'ah a gestational onset.
The intercourse euphemism supplies the generative contact in the metaphor.
Uttered speech is the form brought forth by the generative process.
Birth and delivery provide the later emergence stage of the model.
Origination and beginning generalize birth into the coming-to-form of an utterance.
The womb supplies the containing space in which the metaphorical utterance matures.

changed_reading.before: Nashi'at al-layl is a temporal rising that improves an already available utterance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the night is a gestational interval in which generative contact conceives, forms, and brings forth upright speech.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence changes nocturnal standing from generic devotion into conditioning for receiving and bearing a heavy utterance.
The immediate daytime contrast changes severity into concentrated traction against long, expansive circulation.
The shaking earth, poured mountains, harmful weight, and split sky turn bodily footing and upright speech into portable stability when external supports fail.
The final ayah revises strength through measure, failed enumeration, ease, illness, and travel: effective contact is calibrated fit, not maximal hardship.
The retained non-dominant QLL mapping allows an exploratory echo in which qila carries the repeated qalilan as a small, bearable verbal measure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus couples a bodily contact term with verbal uprightness. Context repeatedly changes that coupling across load-bearing, social restraint, path-making, material collapse, and adaptive measure, while the split QWL mapping and distant wat' branches preserve controlled surprises that a single smooth interpretation would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet permits several nashi'ah images, so temporal rising, enacted practice, and developmental formation remain coexisting rather than resolved.
The causal claim that night practice conditions reception of the heavy saying comes from sequence and branch fit, not an explicit causal marker.
Whether 73:20 retrospectively defines the focus's strength or only grants a later concession remains open.
The QLL echo and the prosodic and gestational outliers are branch-grounded but form-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.
